title: Add tree and symbol invalidation

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python-v1 tree and symbol invalidation capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: Reuse the current-head DatabaseRepositoryIndexer@1 and ASTInvalidation@1 rather than introduce a PCSM wrapper, a second tree identity, or a competing invalidation authority. The selected indexer completes a full, incremental, or reconciliation scan before advancing the authoritative head; binds that head to repository/tree/overlay/parser/policy/scanner identities and a deterministic file ledger; records typed path invalidations; and invalidates symbol, impact, cache, and proof facts on path, parser, or policy drift. The exact-output authority permits only this receipt, so no source or test change was made.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The exact current source forest contains a versioned deterministic invalidation authority and a direct positive/negative test module, but the authoritative sealed Python 3.12 environment reports duckdb_available=False. Its 12 direct tests are dependency-skipped rather than passed. There is also no canonical aggregate PCSM SourceLinkReceipt/source-map CID binding this forest's concrete files, symbols, and scan results. This is therefore a typed capability/dependency-gap assessment, not a promoted PCSM invalidation execution.

selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: DatabaseRepositoryIndexer@1 is the current-head smallest authority that already couples authoritative tree advancement, AST/path invalidation, and dependent symbol currency. Creating a PCSM adapter or a separate invalidation ledger would duplicate its source-tree, parser, policy, snapshot, and fact-currency authorities and exceeds this receipt-only dispatch.

components.role: Deterministic full/incremental/reconciliation scanner. It promotes an authoritative head only after a complete scan, binding repository, tree, overlay, parser, policy, scanner version, scan-run, snapshot, and canonical file ledger.
Durable, canonical-content-identified receipt for source change, deletion, rename, parser drift, policy drift, submodule, and untracked-policy invalidations.
Versioned symbol, impact, cache, and proof facts whose current/invalidated currency is bound to snapshot, parser, and policy identity.
Canonical-content-identified bounded scan coverage/frontier receipt which distinguishes complete authoritative scans from partial work.

determinism_and_binding.identity: AST invalidation and coverage receipt identities derive from canonical JSON with their versioned schemas. Snapshot/head/fact bindings carry exact repository/tree/overlay/parser/policy/scanner/file-ledger or snapshot/parser/policy dimensions. These are content identities, not falsely claimed IPFS CIDs.
determinism_and_binding.tree_invalidation: The indexer calculates deterministic added, changed, deleted, renamed, and unchanged path deltas from the prior and current canonical file ledgers. Notifications are hints only; reconciliation rechecks identity, and a partial/crashed scan does not advance the authoritative head.
determinism_and_binding.symbol_invalidation: For current dependent facts, a path invalidation invalidates facts on that path. Parser or policy drift invalidates all affected current facts; facts on unchanged paths are rebound only when no drift applies. Fact kinds include symbol, impact, cache, and proof.
determinism_and_binding.authority_boundary: The component is derived evidence only. It does not treat a watcher event, model output, scan cursor, partial scan, generic fixture, or receipt as completion, source mutation, M2/M3 mutation, semantic proof, or promotion authority.

source_inventory.role: Current-head DatabaseRepositoryIndexer@1, ASTInvalidation@1, DependentFact@1, authoritative-head advancement, deterministic delta/reconciliation, and tree/symbol invalidation implementation.
Direct positive and negative tree/path/symbol invalidation test module; it is explicitly dependency-gated on DuckDB.
Underlying module reached by the required PCSM suite; recorded separately and never relabelled as tree/symbol invalidation coverage.

positive_coverage_present_but_unexecuted: Full scan advances a tree-bound authoritative head; incremental scan equals a clean full rebuild; missed notification reconciliation recovers a source change; and unchanged facts rebind to the new snapshot.
